text.p: Microlytics Inc said on Friday that it and its subsidiary, Microlytics Technology Co Inc, have filed voluntary petitions for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the federal Bankruptcy Code in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of New York, Rochester Division.

Microlytics stated that its filings were in response to the commencement of several lawsuits against it and its, previously announced, inability to service debt obligations totaling $3.8 million all of which are in substantial default.
Microlytics said it and its subsidiary expect to file their schedules of assets and liabilities and a statement of affairs with the Bankruptcy Court within the next 15 days.
No date has yet been set for the first meeting of creditors in the reorganization cases, it said.

The company said that it plans to continue to support both its MicroPages, a full text retrieval product that was recently licensed to Ameritech Corp's Interactive Media Services Group for use in that company's Internet site, and its strategic partners.
